title: Smart Growth & Austin Development Discussion
summary:
*   City leaders held a special meeting to discuss urban development plans.
*   Key topics included a "Smart Growth Matrix," a framework for sustainable community development, and a specific "Austin Marketplace" construction proposal.
*   The meeting was for briefing and discussion purposes only; no official votes or policy decisions were made on any items.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
August 04, 1998
Mayor Pro Tern Garcia called the meeting to order, Mayor Watson temporarily absent.
The Austin City Council will convene in a special called meeting, for the following
purposes: Briefing and discussion of Smart Growth Matrix and Austin Marketplace
development proposal.
Discussion held, no action taken.
ADJOURNED at 4:50 p.m. on Councilmember Griffith's motion, Councilmember Slusher's second,
7-0 vote.
Approved on this the 13th day of August, 1998 on Councilmember Spelman's motion,
Councilmember Goodman's second, 6-0 vote, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia absent.
